messages:
maria: Heads-up — I opened a TF PR to tweak Karpenter provisioner for our preemptible/spot pool. Main changes: increase drainDelay to 120s, add evictionGracePeriod 120s, set ttlSecondsAfterEmpty to 600, and pin a spot taint.
chris: PR link? id?
maria: https://internal/repo/pull/1423 — TL;DR: reduce node churn on short preemptions and avoid HPA thrash. Consolidation disabled for this provisioner.
sam: Quick question — ttl=600 means empty nodes live 10m. Won't we burn credits?
maria: We modelled it — keeping idle spot nodes for short windows is cheaper than re-provisioning for ~95% of observed preemptions. On-demand pool unchanged.
lee: What about PDBs blocking drains? Any force-evict behavior?
maria: We respect PDBs. For blocking long-running pods we plan a fallback: after 5m attempt, use evictionPolicy: delete for that podclass. Also we'll add disruption budgets for stateful app owners.
sam: Can you paste the terraform snippet so I can eyeball it quickly?
maria: ```hcl
module "karpenter_provisioner_spot" {
  source = "./modules/provisioner"
  name   = "spot-provisioner"
  ttl_seconds_after_empty = 600
  drain_delay_seconds     = 120
  eviction_grace_period_seconds = 120
  taints = ["spot=true:NoSchedule"]
}
```
chris: Sounds reasonable. Did you test HPA spikes? We previously saw pods pending because tolerations/affinity mismatch.
maria: Tested with a synthetic 50% CPU spike on staging. Provisioner created nodes, and our deployment images include tolerations for spot for eligible services. For services that can't tolerate spot we use nodeAffinity to route to on-demand pool.
infra-oncall: Can we add a metric for provisioner_pending_pods and alert at >5 for 10m? We had incidents from pending pods during last rollout.
lee: Also add a dashboard panel for drain failures and last-drain-duration.
maria: Ack — will add metrics + grafana panel + test plan to the PR.
deploy-bot: terraform plan for PR #1423 succeeded in staging :white_check_mark: (plan id: abc123)
chris: @maria can you write a short changelog blurb about cost tradeoffs and a quick revert path? :thumbsup: 
maria: Yep. Revert recipe: set ttl_seconds_after_empty back to 60, drain_delay_seconds to 30, and re-enable consolidation for the provisioner; I will paste helm/terraform rollback commands in the PR.
sam: One last nit — update the runbook/docs to call out expected short transient pending pods during spot preemptions so SREs don't paged unnecessarily.
maria: Added docs and test results to the PR. Thanks all!
